title: lcs-master Routing Eval Kit
description: 20 eval queries (10 positive, 10 negative near-miss) for lcs-master routing accuracy. Uses realistic casual Indonesian + English input.

queries.input: saya mau bikin fitur baru untuk upload file
queries.reason: User wants to explore/brainstorm a new feature → lcs-explore

queries.input: tolong buatkan PRD dari hasil explore yang tadi
queries.reason: User wants to create PRD from exploration → lcs-toprd

queries.input: review prd ini, pastikan gak ada yang kelewat
queries.reason: User wants to review/harden existing PRD → lcs-prd-reviewer

queries.input: ubah PRD jadi SRS yang lebih teknis
queries.reason: User wants to transform PRD to SRS → lcs-tosrs

queries.input: potong SRS jadi task-task kecil yang bisa dikerjakan
queries.reason: User wants to slice SRS into tasks → lcs-task-slicer

queries.input: eksekusi task-001
queries.reason: User wants to execute a specific task → lcs-task-executor

queries.input: ada bug di login, error 500 terus
queries.reason: User reports a bug → lcs-debug

queries.input: review kode yang baru di-push
queries.reason: User wants code review → lcs-code-review

queries.input: onboarding docs untuk developer baru
queries.reason: User wants onboarding documentation → lcs-onboarding

queries.input: finalize dokumentasi yang sudah selesai
queries.reason: User wants to finalize documentation → lcs-doc-finalizer

queries.input: review kode yang baru di-push
queries.reason: Review ≠ execution. Task executor is for implementing, not reviewing.

queries.input: saya mau bikin fitur baru untuk upload file
queries.reason: Exploration ≠ PRD creation ≠ implementation. Explore first.

queries.input: ada bug di login, error 500 terus
queries.reason: Normal debug ≠ debug-ext (which is evidence-only, no fixes).

queries.input: review prd ini, pastikan gak ada yang kelewat
queries.reason: PRD review ≠ code review. Different artifacts, different skills.

queries.input: potong SRS jadi task-task kecil
queries.reason: Slicing ≠ executing. Slicer creates tasks, executor runs them.

queries.input: onboarding docs untuk developer baru
queries.reason: Onboarding ≠ codebase documentation. Different audiences.

queries.input: finalize dokumentasi yang sudah selesai
queries.reason: Finalization ≠ review. Finalizer consolidates, reviewer checks.

queries.input: ubah PRD jadi SRS yang lebih teknis
queries.reason: PRD→SRS ≠ PRD creation. tosrs transforms, toprd creates.

queries.input: eksekusi task-001
queries.reason: Must route to executor (canonical), not executer (deprecated).

queries.input: tolong buatkan PRD dari hasil explore yang tadi
queries.reason: Creating PRD ≠ reviewing PRD. toprd creates, reviewer hardens.
